WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, SUM(f.net_amount) AS s, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS nd
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS d, SUM(r.refund_net) AS rn, COUNT(*) AS rc
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.business_date, c.net_sales_before_returns, c.returns_net, c.net_sales AS ctrl, m.s, m.n, m.nd, r.rn, r.rc, m.s - COALESCE(r.rn,0) - c.net_sales AS diff
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.d=c.business_date LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.d=c.business_date
WHERE c.store_id=116 AND c.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' ORDER BY 1

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS c
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21')
SELECT store_id, c, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l1, max(etl_loaded_at) l2, sum(net_amount) amt
FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING c>1 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN a.net_amount=b.net_amount AND a.quantity=b.quantity AND a.product_key=b.product_key AND a.sale_ts_utc=b.sale_ts_utc AND a.store_key=b.store_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) identical,
 min(a.sales_line_id) a_min, max(a.sales_line_id) a_max, min(b.sales_line_id) b_min, max(b.sales_line_id) b_max, min(a.etl_loaded_at) al, max(a.etl_loaded_at) ah, min(b.etl_loaded_at) bl, max(b.etl_loaded_at) bh
FROM fact_sales_line a JOIN fact_sales_line b ON a.receipt_id=b.receipt_id AND a.line_no=b.line_no AND a.sales_line_id<b.sales_line_id
WHERE a.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day,
       ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS per_day_2dp, cs.open_date, cs.close_date
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
